summary: New nether biomes don t work properly in buffet worlds
description: The bug The new nether biomes (nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas) do not work in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce - Create New World - Select More World Options - Make a buffet world - Select Soul Sand Valley - Set terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode Freezes the game before it even loads terrain (Image Below) -Surface mode creates a purely ocean world (This happened the first time i tried to make one but works fine now for some reason) The following list is updated in version 20w15a: Biomes All world generators that freeze the game Nether wastes Surface Crimson forest Surface Warped forest Surface and floating islands Soul sand valley Surface Basalt deltas Surface
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world.
2. Select "More World Options".
3. Choose to create a Buffet world.
4. Set the biome selection to Soul Sand Valley.
5. Set the terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode.
6. Attempt to load the newly created world.
7. Observe that the game freezes before loading any terrain.
8. Note if the freeze occurs repeatedly when attempting to load the world again.
Observed Behavior:
The new nether biomes, including Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas, do not function properly in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce the issue, create a new world and select More World Options to configure it as a buffet world. When selecting one of these nether biomes, such as Soul Sand Valley, and setting the terrain type to either Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode, the game freezes before loading any terrain. In Surface mode, attempting to generate a world often results in a purely oceanic biome, though this issue seems inconsistent. The problematic behavior affects all listed biomes across both Surface and Floating Island modes, causing the game to freeze entirely without generating any nether-specific features or terrain.

This bug impacts specific combinations of world types and biomes, including Nether Wastes, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Soul Sand Valley, and Basalt Deltas in both Surface and Floating Island settings. The issue was observed as early as version 20w15a and continues to affect all relevant biome-world generator configurations.
Expected Behavior: When creating a buffet world with new nether biomes such as Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, or Basalt Deltas, and setting the terrain type to Surface or Floating Islands, the game should generate the selected biome correctly without freezing. The player should be able to explore these biomes in both surface and floating island modes without encountering any world generation issues.
